segments.text:
Nadab, who began to reigne in the second
yeere of Asa, might reigne 2. yeres, although Baasha succeed him in the third yeere of Asa; because the last yeeres of the Kings of Israel and Iuda are not fully expired, but some of them (as in this place) doe scarsely containe moneths in them: the rest of the yeeres being put compleately.
